title: L4DC 2027
about: The 9th Annual Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference takes place June 16-18, 2027 in Stockholm. It invites theoretical, applied and empirical papers at the intersection of machine learning, control and optimization, submitted through OpenReview using the L4DC LaTeX template.

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "Machine learning, control and optimization" → "Reinforcement learning (RL): Q-learning, policy gradients, actor-critic, RLHF"
"theoretical, applied and empirical papers at the intersection of machine learning" → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"

card_alt: Card for L4DC 2027, a call for papers from the Learning for Dynamics & Control Conference (L4DC) in Stockholm, Sweden, with a paper submission deadline of 13 Nov 2026. The photo is an aerial view of the colourful old-town buildings of Gamla Stan and Riddarholmen in Stockholm, with the spire of Riddarholmen Church and the waterfront.
